description: Leaves one short note on an app module; the latest note per module shows on that module's own screen. Modules: dashboard.next_payment, dashboard.active_commitments, dashboard.next_30_days, dashboard.this_month, dashboard.by_account, dashboard.by_category, account.<id>, member.<id>. There are no reports.* modules: the Reports screen shows the months longbook drew. A note is a sentence or two. Notes are appended, and the last note per module wins.
name: leave_insight
title: Leave an insight
